Bank Teller Job at Lington & Bernie Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        Lington & Bernie Consulting Limited was established on October 8, 1999 to provide efficient and qualitative consulting services to the oil and gas industry as well as banks and financial institutions in the areas of human resources placement and management, human resources consulting services, tax administration and payroll services as well as oil and gas fiscal and contractual terms advisory services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Bank Teller 

Job Location: Makurdi, Old Otukpo Road Branch - Benue
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

            
    




	Bank Tellers facilitate financial transactions initiated by customers, including deposits, withdrawals, money transfers and sometimes loan applications.


Responsibilities
Your Bank Teller job description may include these duties and responsibilities:


	Taking and dispensing money for deposits and withdrawals
	Cashing checks
	Processing loan payments
	Overseeing drive-through transactions
	Counting and packaging currency deliveries
	Taking inventory of cash drawers at the beginning and end of shifts
	Conducting foreign currency exchanges
	Discussing the merits of bank products and services, such as account types and credit assets
	Assisting with the opening of new accounts, such as checking, savings and money market accounts (MMAs).


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Business Manager Job at Syx-Brij Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Syx-Brij Nigeria Limited - Our client, Paz Diagnostic, located at 76TOS Benson Road (Beach Road), opposite NNPC Filling Station, General Hospital Road, Ebute, Ikorodu, Lagos State.

They are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Manager 

Job Location: Ikorodu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	Our client is seeking a highly organized, strategic, and results-driven Business Manager to oversee the day-to-day business operations of the diagnostic centre and drive sustainable growth.
	The successful candidate will work closely with management and various departments to improve operational efficiency, strengthen client and partner relationships, increase revenue, and ensure the smooth delivery of diagnostic services.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee the day-to-day business and administrative operations of Paz Diagnostics.
	Develop and implement strategies to improve revenue, profitability, and overall business performance.
	Identify new business opportunities and develop relationships with HMOs, hospitals, clinics, corporate organizations, government agencies, and other partners.
	Monitor the performance of business development, marketing, HMO, and customer service activities.
	Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders.
	Monitor revenue, expenses, operational costs, and other key business performance indicators.
	Work with the finance team to improve financial controls, budgeting, and cost management.
	Coordinate with clinical and laboratory teams to ensure efficient service delivery and excellent patient experience.
	Develop strategies to increase patient volume, corporate accounts, referrals, and repeat business.
	Monitor market trends and competitor activities and recommend strategies to maintain a competitive advantage.
	Support the development and implementation of marketing, promotional, and community outreach initiatives.
	Prepare regular business performance reports for management.
	Identify operational challenges and implement practical solutions to improve efficiency.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, industry standards, and relevant healthcare regulations.
	Lead and coordinate administrative and business support teams where required.
	Represent Paz Diagnostics at meetings, networking events, partnership discussions, and business engagements.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Healthcare Management, Marketing, or a related field.
	3–5 years of experience in business management, operations, business development, healthcare management, or a related role.
	Experience in a diagnostic centre, hospital, HMO, or other healthcare organization is highly desirable.
	Strong understanding of business operations, revenue generation, customer relationship management, and performance management.
	Proven ability to develop partnerships and drive business growth.
	Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and business management/CRM tools.
	Ability to work independently, manage multiple responsibilities, and deliver results.
	Strong commercial awareness and a target-driven mindset.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
	Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
	A dynamic and collaborative working environment.
	The opportunity to play a key role in the growth and expansion of a modern diagnostic healthcare business.

title: Job Openings at ETC Workforce Services Limited
content:
ETC Workforce Services Limited is a leading Workforce Management, HR Consulting and Recruitment Organization; Empowering businesses to focus on their core competencies while we handle the complexities of HR, staffing, and operational support. With a client-centric approach, cutting-edge solutions, and a team of dedicated experts, we streamline processes and drive growth, allowing our partners to thrive in today's competitive landscape.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Security Officer 

Job Location: Ajah, Epe, Chevron, and Island Area -  Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking qualified, experienced, and reliable candidates to join its team across variousfront-of-house, kitchen, operations, delivery, cleaning, and security roles.


Responsibility


	Maintain a safe and secure environment for customers, staff, visitors, management and company property through access control, monitoring, security checks and prompt response to incidents.


What We’re Looking For


	Candidates with the relevant training, knowledge and practical experience
	Previous experience in security operations
	Strong communication, teamwork, professionalism, discipline, reliability and attention to detail.
	Ability to work effectively in a busy restaurant and lounge environmentand during peak periods, events and special occasions where required.


Salary
Negotiable (Salary: N120,000 - N350,000 monthly)

Application Closing Date: 30th September, 2026.

Click here to apply online

Note


	Qualified candidates should complete the application form below and upload their updated CV.
	Kindly select the specific position you are applying for in the application form.


 

 

2.) Head Waiter 

Job Location: Ajah, Epe, Chevron, Island Area - Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	They are seeking qualified, experienced, and reliable candidates to join its team across various front-of-house, kitchen, operations, delivery, cleaning, and security roles.
	Head Waiter - Supervise front-of-house service, coordinate waiters and restaurant attendants, manage table allocation and service flow, and ensure efficient, professional, and welcoming customer service.


What We’re Looking For


	Candidates with the relevant education, training, knowledge and practical experience applicable to the position being applied for.
	Previous experience in restaurant, hotel, catering, hospitality, commercial kitchen, customer service, delivery, cleaning or security operations, depending on the role.
	Strong communication, teamwork, professionalism, discipline, reliability and attention to detail.
	Ability to work effectively in a busy restaurant and lounge environment and during peak periods, events and special occasions where required
	Candidates applying for specialized or supervisory roles should possess the relevant technical, leadership and operational experience required for the position.


Salary
Negotiable.

Application Closing Date: 30th September, 2026.

Click here to apply online

Note


	Candidates should complete the application form below and upload their updated CV.
	Kindly select the specific position you are applying for in the application form.


 

 

3.) Accountant 

Job Location: Wuse 2, Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Schedule: Monday – Saturday | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Job Summary


	Our client, a growing hair restoration and aesthetic clinic, specializing in hair transplant procedures and non-surgical hair restoration treatments, is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accountant to oversee financial reporting, accounting operations, and financial controls while supporting effective financial management of the business.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee day-to-day accounting and financial operations
	Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports
	Manage general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable
	Prepare and review financial statements, reconciliations and management reports
	Monitor cash flow, budgets and financial performance
	Ensure accurate and timely recording of financial transactions
	Maintain strong financial controls and ensure compliance with accounting policies and procedures
	Coordinate tax, audit and statutory reporting requirements
	Review financial records and identify discrepancies or control gaps
	Support budgeting, forecasting and financial planning
	Supervise and guide junior accounting staff where applicable
	Provide management with accurate financial insights to support decision-making


What We’re Looking For


	Minimum 3–5 years of relevant accounting experience*, preferably in a senior accounting role
	Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field
	Professional accounting qualification such as ICAN, ACCA or equivalent is required or strongly preferred
	Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting and internal controls
	Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel
	Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills
	Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
	Strong communication and organisational skills
	Ability to manage deadlines and work effectively in a fast-paced environment
	High level of integrity, professionalism and accountability
	Experience managing or supervising accounting personnel is an advantage


Salary
N350,000 - N600,000 per month.

Application Closing Date: 20th September, 2026.

Click here to apply online

Note:


	This is a Senior-level Accounting position and requires proven experience handling financial operations, reporting and accounting controls. Entry-level applicants and candidates without substantial relevant accounting experience should not apply.
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
